question: In which language is the Hathigumpha Inscription engraved?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pali**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is on the Udayagiri-Khandagiri hills located in the Khordha district of Odisha. 
 
• The language of this inscription is **Pali** and the script is Brahmi. 
 
• It contains a systematic description of the 13-year rule of Kharavela after he became king. 
 
• This inscription was discovered by Bishop Stalling in 1825.
 
• The inscription **was created by King Kharavela of the Mahameghavahana dynasty, who ruled over the region known as Kalinga.**
